health.description: Health smoke check. Returns v2 response envelope (schemaVersion 2): verdict PASS when ok, payload {status,service,checkedAt}, digest.chatOneLiner for status lines.

conversation.description: Model-free echo with thread memory. Thin v2 response wrapper (verdict PASS, payload reply/steps) for the shared coordinator decoder.

closeout_review.description: Closeout review → v2 response (PASS|FAIL|ERROR). Lean changeSet: files[{path,status}]+diff --git only (content discouraged; oversized content → ERROR). Prose-only diff → ERROR changeset.required. Branch on response.verdict. See docs/graph-response-v2.md.

test_development.description: TestDev → v2 response with DomainPin domains, payload.testCases/gaps (blocking gaps → FAIL), dual-domain FE ng / BE bun. Existing test loci only. Slim contextRef by default. See docs/graph-response-v2.md.

software_dev.description: SoftDev → v2 response with DomainPin domains and structured payload.plan[] (domain/kind/paths/commands). Mixed = dual-domain. Branch on response.verdict (ERROR=bad input). See docs/graph-response-v2.md.
